evidence.test: edge >= +3%: +2 | >= +1%: +1 | <= -1%: -1 | <= -3%: -2 (capped at 1 point: backtest error 11.4% is not better than no-change 10.1%)
evidence.source: Dharalu forecast (backtest error 11.37% vs no-change 10.05%, 244 tests)
evidence.why: Holding metal only pays if the expected rise beats the interest the money would earn.
evidence.weight_why: did worse than the usual rate (-1.5 points) - not counted

evidence.weight_why: did worse than the usual rate (-7.2 points) - not counted

evidence.value: 7-day avg Rs 1,83,693 vs 30-day avg Rs 1,97,676; 30-day change -14.1%

evidence.source: World price x Rs rate, last ~9 months
evidence.why: Metals move in long waves; going with the big trend avoids fighting it.

long_term.label: GO SLOW
long_term.advice: The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now.
long_term.advice_te: దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి.
long_term.why: Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average). Not counted (its record disagrees): Price vs 3-year average.
long_term.why_te: కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).

evidence.test: at or below the average: +1 (cheap for the long run) | 30%+ above: -1 (far above)
evidence.why: on such days the next year was +44% vs +35% usually - the record disagrees, NOT counted

evidence.test: fell 10%+: +1 | rose 30%+: -1 (a fast run-up often cools)
above: +1 (the long wave is up) | below: -1
evidence.why: on such days the next year was +25% vs +35% usually - agrees, counts

long_term.record_line: Past GO SLOW days: 1 year later +25% on average (higher on 80%) vs +35% for any day (higher on 78%).
long_term.note: Graded on the price 1 year later over about 6 years. Those years overlap (about one independent result per year), and the rules were switched on/off using the same years, so read it as a guide, not proof.

forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 10.7% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-9.7%).
forecast_reason.telugu: 30 రోజుల్లో సుమారు 10.7% తగ్గవచ్చు. ప్రధాన కారణం: ఇటీవలి ధోరణి (-9.7%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 14.2% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.5% lower in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is above the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day jump only half, so it starts 0.6% lower than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -23.6% to +9.0% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 11.4% on average at 30 days, vs 10.1% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 55% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

where.short: All-India import price · world spot + 6% duty, before GST
where.short_te: అఖిల భారత దిగుమతి ధర · ప్రపంచ ధర + 6% సుంకం, GST లేకుండా
where.detail: World spot XAG in US$ per troy ounce (gold-api.com; history COMEX SI=F, Yahoo Finance) x the US$/Rs rate (Yahoo INR=X) + 6% import duty, for 999 fine. The same for all of India - not a Srikakulam jeweller's rate: shops add their own premium, making charges and 3% GST on top.

rules.telugu:
2026-10-20 వెండి - కొనండి (స్కోరు +1 / 5)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: ధర ఈ ఏడాది పరిధిలో తక్కువ భాగంలో ఉంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 1,94,428 (+4.2%) కి పెరిగితే వేచి ఉండండి. ధర 15% తగ్గినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో BUY రోజుల్లో (935 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 66% సార్లు ధర పెరిగింది; ఏ రోజైనా 55% (తేడా +11).
ధర: కిలోకు Rs 1,86,501 (GST తో Rs 1,92,096); 7 రోజుల్లో -3.4%, 30 రోజుల్లో -14.1%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 1,66,501 (Rs 1,42,399 - Rs 2,03,255).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: నెమ్మదిగా కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి. కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).
